title: ccBench's suites for every controller, with the rules on net1 v5
description: ccBench's games are between the controllers of one run, so the rules on net1 v5 (exp-ccbench-v5-89, planned with --only so its episodes are those of the full run) are ranked against the stock controllers and Sage of exp-ccbench-78 by merging the two runs' campaigns (their shards have distinct names; BBRv3 ran in both, with identical episodes and metrics) and leaving out the rules on net1 v4 (experiments/ccbench_report.py EXCLUDE). No episode is run here.
run: for c in "$IN/a"/c-*; do n=$(basename "$c"); mkdir -p "$OUT/$n/shards"; for d in "$IN/a/$n"/shards/* "$IN/b/$n"/shards/*; do ln -s "$d" "$OUT/$n/shards/$(basename "$d")"; done; done; jq -s add "$IN/a/aliases.json" "$IN/b/aliases.json" > "$OUT/aliases.json"; uv run python experiments/ccbench_report.py "$OUT" rule-v4 share-k1; rm -rf "$OUT"/c-*
